title: Madagascar: Wild Nights & Island Wonder: From baobab sunsets to Antananarivo after dark — Madagascar for two
description: A 4-day adventure through Madagascar blending family-friendly wildlife encounters by day with vibrant nightlife after sundown. Explore lemur reserves, spice markets, and the beating heart of Tana's music scene.

activities.name: Arrive & Settle In
activities.description: Land at Ivato International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in central Tana. Freshen up and grab breakfast.
details: 📍 Stay near Analakely or Haute Ville for walkability
🕐 Airport transfer: ~45 min depending on traffic

activities.name: Rova of Antananarivo & Haute Ville Walk
activities.description: Visit the historic Queen's Palace (Rova) perched atop the city's highest hill. Wander through Haute Ville's colorful streets and craft markets. Stroll around the heart-shaped lake, then dive into the bustling Analakely market for spices, vanilla, and street food.
details: 📍 Rova of Antananarivo — panoramic city views
🎨 Pick up local woodcarvings and raffia crafts
⏱️ Allow 2-3 hours
🛒 Vanilla beans here are the cheapest in the world
📸 Great photo ops at the angel monument on Lac Anosy

activities.name: Live Music & Nightlife in Isoraka
activities.description: Tana's Isoraka neighborhood is the nightlife hub. Catch live salegy music (Madagascar's signature dance genre), grab rhum arrangé cocktails, and dance until late.
details: 🎵 Check Kudeta Club or Le Glacier for live bands
🍹 Rhum arrangé = rum infused with local fruits and vanilla
🕙 Scene picks up around 10 PM

activities.name: Drive to Andasibe
activities.description: Scenic 3-hour drive east through rice paddies and highland villages. Stop at a reptile farm along RN2 to see chameleons and leaf-tailed geckos.
details: 🚗 Hire a driver (~$80/day including fuel)
📍 Marozevo Reptile Farm — great family stop
⏱️ Depart by 7 AM to maximize park time

activities.name: Andasibe-Mantadia National Park
activities.description: Guided hike through primary rainforest to find the indri — the largest living lemur. Their haunting calls echo for miles. Also spot bamboo lemurs, tenrecs, and dozens of bird species.
details: 🐒 Indri lemurs are found nowhere else on Earth
🎫 Park entry + guide: ~$15/person
🌧️ Trails can be muddy — waterproof shoes essential
⏱️ 3-4 hour guided walk

activities.name: Night Walk in Vakôna Forest
activities.description: A magical guided night walk to spot mouse lemurs, chameleons that glow under UV light, and the famous leaf-tailed gecko. Family-friendly and unforgettable.
details: 🔦 Guides provide flashlights
🦎 Chameleons are easier to spot at night!
⏱️ 1-2 hours, starts after dark

days.title: Andasibe → Tana — Lemur Island & Nightlife Round 2

activities.name: Vakôna Lemur Island
activities.description: Take a canoe to a small island where semi-tame lemurs will jump onto your shoulders. Incredibly fun and perfect for photos. Sifakas, brown lemurs, and bamboo lemurs roam freely.
details: 🐒 Lemurs will literally sit on your head
📸 Best photo opportunity of the trip
🎫 ~$10/person
⏱️ 1-2 hours

activities.name: Drive Back to Tana + Ambohimanga
activities.description: Return to the capital, stopping at the UNESCO World Heritage site of Ambohimanga — the sacred royal hill. Beautiful gardens and historical significance.
details: 📍 Ambohimanga — "Blue Hill", sacred to Malagasy people
🏛️ Former royal residence with original furnishings
🎫 ~$5/person entry
⏱️ 1 hour visit

activities.name: Rooftop Drinks & Club Night
activities.description: Start with sunset cocktails at a rooftop bar, then head to one of Tana's clubs for dancing. The city comes alive on weekends with a mix of salegy, afrobeats, and French pop.
details: 🍸 Hotel Colbert rooftop bar for sunset views
🎶 Le Carnivore or Pandora Club for dancing
🕙 Clubs peak around midnight

activities.name: Tsimbazaza Zoo & Botanical Garden
activities.description: A relaxed morning at Madagascar's main zoo, home to lemurs, fossa, and radiated tortoises you can't see in the wild easily. The attached botanical garden has endemic plants.
details: 🐢 Radiated tortoises are critically endangered
🌺 Baobab and traveler's palm specimens
🎫 ~$3/person
⏱️ 1.5 hours

activities.name: Souvenir Shopping & Departure
activities.description: Pick up last-minute vanilla, spices, and hand-carved rosewood crafts at the Digue Market. Then head to Ivato Airport for your departure.
details: 🛒 Digue Market — best prices on vanilla and crafts
✈️ Allow 2 hours for airport (traffic!)
📦 Vanilla packs flat and makes the best souvenir
